seo.title: 4-Day Desert Tour from Marrakech to Merzouga | Erg Chebbi & Dades (2026)
seo.metaDescription: From €360 pp. Relaxed 4-day Marrakech desert tour to Merzouga (private VIP or shared). Includes Erg Chebbi dunes, camel ride, luxury camp & High Atlas mountains.
seo.lead: A 4-day private desert expedition from Marrakech crossing the High Atlas Mountains via the Tizi n'Tichka pass (2,260m). The circuit explores Kasbah Ait Ben Haddou, the dramatic canyons of Dades and Todra Gorges, and includes a sunset camel trek to an overnight luxury bivouac in the golden Erg Chebbi dunes before returning via Ouarzazate.
seo.primaryKeyword: 4 day desert tour from Marrakech to Merzouga

price.label: From EUR 360 per person
price.note: Price includes private air-conditioned 4x4 or minivan transport, licensed driver-guide, 2 nights in boutique riads/hotels (Dades Valley & Ouarzazate), 1 night in Erg Chebbi desert bivouac, camel trek, dinners, and daily breakfasts.

seo.imageAlt: Camel caravan trekking across golden Erg Chebbi dunes at sunrise during a 4-day Marrakech to Merzouga desert tour
highlights: Cross the High Atlas Mountains via the dramatic Tizi n'Tichka pass at 2,260 meters elevation
Guided walk through the UNESCO World Heritage earthen citadel of Kasbah Ait Ben Haddou
Marvel at the towering 300-meter sheer limestone canyon walls of Todra Gorges
Sunset and sunrise camel trek across the sweeping orange dunes of Erg Chebbi in Merzouga
Overnight in a traditional desert camp with freshly prepared tagines, campfire, and Berber drums
Relaxed 4-day pacing with dedicated stops in the Valley of Roses, Skoura Palm Grove, and Ouarzazate

faqs.question: Why choose a 4-day desert tour over a 3-day itinerary?
faqs.answer: The 4-day route covers roughly 1,100 km round-trip with shorter daily driving legs (4 to 5 hours instead of 7 to 8 hours). You enjoy dedicated leisure time in Dades Valley and Ouarzazate, avoiding long hurried stretches across the High Atlas.

faqs.question: What is the accommodation standard during the 4-day desert expedition?
faqs.answer: You stay two nights in characterful boutique riads or hotels (Night 1 in Dades Valley, Night 3 in Ouarzazate) and one night in a desert camp in the Erg Chebbi dunes. Luxury tent upgrades with private ensuite hot showers and flush toilets are readily available.

faqs.question: Can this 4-day tour end in Fes instead of returning to Marrakech?
faqs.answer: Yes. On Day 3, instead of looping toward Ouarzazate, you can travel north through the Ziz Valley, Midelt, and the cedar forests of Azrou to conclude in Fes by early evening.

faqs.question: What meals are included during the tour?
faqs.answer: All breakfasts and traditional evening dinners (Moroccan tagines, couscous, fresh seasonal fruits) at your riads and desert bivouac are fully included. Lunches and personal beverages are purchased independently at scenic local stops.

faqs.question: What clothing and essentials should I pack for the Sahara?
faqs.answer: Bring comfortable walking shoes, polarized sunglasses, high-SPF sunscreen, a turban or scarf for desert breeze, and warm evening layers. Nighttime temperatures in the Sahara drop substantially between November and April.
